_about: The in-app AI trainer's lines (M29): cue id -> variants. Generated with ElevenLabs (the Tech Narrator voice) into Assets/_Project/Audio/Trainer/<cue>_<n>.mp3. A training demo: never 'certified' or 'compliant'.
greet_first: Welcome to Factory VR Safety Training. I'm your trainer. Pick a drill on the board in front of you, and I'll talk you through it.
greet_back: Welcome back. Today's challenge is on the board: nail it for double XP.
Good to see you again. Ready to earn some XP?
hub_back: Back at the hub. Pick your next drill.
Nice. What's next on the board?
intro_robot_1: Robot cell, level one. Walk towards the cell. In the yellow zone the arm slows down, in the red zone it stops. Then reset it from outside the zone.
intro_robot_2: Level two: servicing the cell. Stop the line at the control station, go into the cell, come back out, reset from outside, and restart the line.
intro_robot_3: Level three. A part has jammed at the gate. Stop the line, go in and clear it, then come out, reset and restart. And watch out: if a colleague walks into the cell, stop the line.
intro_robot_4: Level four, the assessment. This one counts. Show me everything you've learned.
intro_lockout: Lockout, tagout. The machining centre has a fault. Shut it down, isolate it, put your lock and tag on, then try to start it. If it can start, you're not safe yet.
intro_fire: Fire safety. When the fire starts, raise the alarm first. Then pick the right extinguisher and sweep at the base. If it grows past the incipient stage, get out.
intro_electrical: Electrical safety. Before you touch that cabinet, gear up. Put on every piece of arc flash PPE on the board, in order.
intro_free: Free roam. Take your time and explore the cell. Keep out of the robot's red zone.
mistake: Careful. That one costs you points.
Not quite. Think about the order.
refused: Not yet. Check what's still missing.
fire_leave: It's past the incipient stage. Leave it, and get out by your exit route.
ppe_done: You're suited up. Now, over to the cabinet.
result_3: Three stars! Flawless. That's how a pro does it.
result_2: Two stars. A solid run, with one small slip to tidy up.
result_1: One star. You passed. Check the card for what to look at again.
result_fail: Not this time. Read the card, then give it another go.
result_critical: That run had a critical mistake. In a real plant, that could hurt someone. Read what went wrong, then try again.
result_scored: Drill complete. Check your points on the card.
daily_done: Daily challenge complete. Double XP is yours.
streak: Your training streak is still going. Come back tomorrow to keep it alive.
coach_robot_warn_in: Walk towards the arm until you're in the yellow zone.
coach_robot_warn_out: See it slow down? Now step back out.
coach_robot_stop_in: Now step into the red zone, and watch the arm stop.
coach_robot_stop_out: Step back out. Notice it doesn't restart by itself.
coach_robot_reset: Press the reset at the control station, from outside the zone.
coach_robot_line_stop: First, stop the line at the control station.
coach_robot_enter: The line's stopped. Now you can go into the cell.
coach_robot_clear: Stand at the gate for three seconds to clear the part.
coach_robot_exit: Done in there. Come back out of the cell.
coach_robot_colleague: Keep watching. If anyone walks into the cell, stop the line.
coach_robot_recover: Your colleague is clear. Reset if you need to, then restart the line.
coach_lockout_0: First, read the machine's energy control procedure on the board.
coach_lockout_1: Tell the affected employees you're about to lock it out.
coach_lockout_3: Isolate the machining centre at its main isolator.
coach_lockout_4: Apply your lock and your tag to the isolator.
coach_lockout_5: Release the stored energy: let the spindle stop, and dump the air.
coach_lockout_6: Now verify it. Try to start the machine. Nothing should move.
coach_lockout_8: Inspect your work: tools out, guards back on.
coach_lockout_9: Check the area. Make sure everyone's clear.
coach_lockout_10: Now remove your lock and tag.
coach_lockout_11: Let everyone know the lock and tag are off.
coach_fire_pin: Good. Now grab the right extinguisher for this class of fire, and pull the pin.
coach_fire_aim: Aim the hose low, at the base of the fire.
coach_fire_squeeze: Squeeze the handle, and sweep side to side.
coach_fire_keep: It's down, but keep sweeping until it's fully out.
coach_fire_out: Fire's out. Well done. Stay alert for a reflash.
coach_ppe_1: First, the arc-rated balaclava. Hold it to your head.
coach_ppe_4: The hard hat with the arc-rated face shield.
coach_ppe_5: The arc-rated jacket. Hold it against your chest.
coach_ppe_6: Last, the rubber insulating gloves with their leather protectors.
coach_elec_q1: Switch the disconnect, Q one, to off.
coach_elec_lock: Now hang your padlock and tag on Q one.
coach_elec_sources: Before you trust that zero, ask yourself: is anything else feeding this cabinet?
coach_elec_backfeed: Stop! The control circuit is still live, fed from the UPS. Open the UPS breaker, and lock it too.
coach_elec_door: You're locked out. Now open the cabinet door.
coach_elec_dc: Wait. The drive's DC bus still holds a charge. Give it time to discharge.
coach_elec_safe: Everything reads dead, and it's locked. That's a safe cabinet.
